title: Reaction Wheel Momentum Desaturation via Magnetorquer Cross-Coupling
summary: Procedure to relieve accumulated angular momentum in 3-axis reaction wheels using geomagnetic torque interaction through magnetorquer coils, avoiding thruster propellant expenditure.
triggers: Reaction wheel speed exceeds nominal upper threshold (RW_SPEED > 5500 RPM)
Attitude pointing error rate exceeds 0.05 deg/min with wheel saturation indicator
Calculated accumulated angular momentum H_rw > 0.85 * H_max (0.085 N·m·s)
telemetry_signatures: Reaction wheel RPM monotonic upward trend approaching or exceeding 5500 RPM
Attitude error divergence starting at 0.1 deg and escalating past 0.5 deg
Thermal panel bearing temperature rise delta > 5°C due to increased viscous friction
Bus voltage drops under sustained high motor drive torque demand
root_causes: Secular external disturbance torque (gravity gradient + aerodynamic drag) during solar storm
Tachometer sensor drift causing closed-loop bias accumulation
Prolonged high-inclination nadir-pointing hold during eclipse passage
remediation_steps: Verify geomagnetic field vector B from fluxgate magnetometer payload telemetry
Confirm satellite is within active line-of-sight communication window (LOS > 180s)
Configure magnetorquer cross-coupling gain matrix to orthogonal projection (M = -k * (H x B))
Execute safe desaturation pulse sequence on RW-02 and RW-03 over 4 orbital cycles
Verify reaction wheel deceleration rate does not exceed maximum allowable slew rate (0.2 deg/s^2)
postconditions: Reaction wheel speed returns to nominal operational range (2000 - 3200 RPM)
Pointing attitude error settles below 0.15 degrees within 120 seconds
Thermal equilibrium restored on wheel drive electronics
Cryptographic entry appended to mission audit ledger
content: SOP-ADCS-042: Reaction Wheel Momentum Desaturation via Magnetorquer Cross-Coupling. Applicable to LEO satellites experiencing reaction wheel saturation exceeding 5500 RPM and attitude error divergence above 0.50 degrees. Standard ECSS-E-ST-70-11C. Remediation requires verified geomagnetic B-field alignment, operator approval Level-2, pre-flight validation of bus voltage > 26.5V, and 300s lookahead kinematic digital twin simulation proving peak slew rate < 0.25 deg/s.

title: Attitude Pointing Loss & Safe Sun-Pointing Transition
summary: Emergency procedure when 3-axis pointing is completely lost or attitude error exceeds 3.0 degrees, placing satellite in coarse sun-pointing safe mode using coarse sun sensors and B-dot magnetic damping.
triggers: Attitude pointing error > 3.0 deg sustained for > 30 seconds
Star tracker loss of lock on both optical heads simultaneously
Tumbler rate detected > 1.0 deg/sec on any body axis
telemetry_signatures: Reaction wheel runaway or multiple wheel tachometer failures
root_causes: Dual star tracker occultation or blindness due to lunar intrusion
Structural thermal shock causing optical bench deflection
remediation_steps: Transition ADCS state machine from 3-Axis Fine Nadir Pointing to Sun-Acquisition Safe Mode
Engage B-dot rate damping algorithm using magnetorquer coils
Orient +Z solar array normal towards sun vector using Coarse Sun Sensors
Inhibit payload instrument power to conserve battery state of charge
postconditions: Body rates reduced to < 0.1 deg/s on all axes
Solar array generating > 180W continuously in sunlight
Battery state of charge stabilizing above 75%
content: SOP-ADCS-019: Attitude Pointing Loss & Safe Sun-Pointing Transition. Applied when pointing error exceeds 3.0 deg or catastrophic loss of star trackers occurs. T3 senior gated emergency procedure commanding B-dot damping and coarse sun pointing.

title: Power Bus Undervoltage Mitigation & Autonomous Load Shedding
summary: Autonomous and operator-guided protocols for handling primary 28V regulated power bus drops below safety threshold (26.5V).
triggers: Main power bus voltage < 26.5V for more than 5 consecutive telemetry frames
Battery Depth of Discharge (DoD) exceeds 35% during eclipse
Solar array current unexpectedly below prediction by > 25%
telemetry_signatures: solar_array_w diminished below 160W during sunlit orbital arc
root_causes: Spacecraft off-pointing resulting in oblique solar array sun angle
Sustained peak current demand from ADCS actuators or high-power transmitter
remediation_steps: Command load shed Tier-1: Power down non-critical payload payloads and heaters
Verify battery charge regulator transitions into constant-current bulk charge
Coordinate with ADCS team to optimize solar array angle of incidence
postconditions: Battery state of charge trend positive
content: SOP-EPS-011: Power Bus Undervoltage Mitigation & Autonomous Load Shedding. Handles bus voltage drops below 26.5V or power margin < 60%. Mandates immediate payload shedding and solar array orientation check.

title: Reaction Wheel & Drive Electronics Thermal Excursion Remediation
summary: Mitigation steps when reaction wheel bearing or drive electronics temperature exceeds 45.0°C due to sustained high RPM or anomalous friction.
triggers: Motor winding current correlated with thermal ramp
telemetry_signatures: Radiator cold plate temperature above seasonal model
root_causes: Bearing lubricant degradation under microgravity vacuum
Continuous peak motor torque demand during momentum saturation
Solar array back-radiation impingement on thermal louvers
remediation_steps: Initiate momentum desaturation to reduce wheel operating speed to < 3000 RPM
Rotate spacecraft attitude 15 degrees to shield radiator panel from albedo/solar flux
Activate auxiliary passive heat pipe loop valve if temperature exceeds 48°C
postconditions: Wheel motor temperature stabilized within nominal operating envelope
content: SOP-THERMAL-005: Reaction Wheel & Drive Electronics Thermal Excursion Remediation. Applied when thermal panel or bearing temperatures cross 45.0°C. Coupled with wheel desaturation and attitude thermal roll adjustment.

title: Hydrazine / Cold Gas Thruster Assisted Momentum Dumping
summary: High-authority momentum unloading utilizing RCS pulse thrusters when magnetic torquers are insufficient due to orbit geometry or rapid divergence.
triggers: Reaction wheel speed > 5800 RPM with magnetorquer duty cycle at 100%
Geomagnetic field intensity B < 15 microTesla at equatorial pass
telemetry_signatures: magnetorquer_current_a saturated at 1.0A without adequate momentum reduction
root_causes: Low magnetic field latitude pass during peak disturbance torque event
remediation_steps: Verify thruster catbed temperature > 350°C and propellant tank pressure > 18 bar
Obtain Dual Senior Flight Director authorization (T3 Risk Gated)
Command 50ms discrete thruster pulses coupled with RW deceleration
Confirm propellant mass budget delta < 0.045 kg
postconditions: All thruster latch valves commanded CLOSED and pressure isolated
content: SOP-PROP-004: Thruster Assisted Momentum Dumping. T3 Senior Flight Director gated procedure for high-authority wheel desaturation when magnetic torquers fail to relieve momentum.

title: Autonomous Safe Mode Entry and Spacecraft Health Isolation
summary: Top-level Failure Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) procedure executed by onboard autonomy or ground override to ensure vehicle survivability.
triggers: Onboard watchdog timeout or fatal software exception
Unrecoverable attitude divergence exceeding safe thresholds
telemetry_signatures: FDIR state flag switches to SAFE_HOLD
Transponder set to omni-directional low-rate telemetry beacon
root_causes: Single Event Upset (SEU) in primary flight computer memory
remediation_steps: Isolate faulty subsystem bus
Broadcast emergency heartbeat beacon at 1200 bps
Await ground station pass for diagnostic dump
postconditions: Spacecraft stable, thermally safe, positive power balance secured
content: SOP-SAFE-001: Autonomous Safe Mode Entry and Spacecraft Health Isolation. Default spacecraft protection protocol isolating non-essential loads, activating low-rate omni communications, and prioritizing power and thermal safety.
